$comment: Content pin for the vendored model catalog (hunk 6). The generator fetches models.dev and two live provider catalogs at run time, so re-hydrating pulls third-party state as of the day it runs, not as of the adopted upstream tag. This record makes that movement visible: model-catalog.mjs --check fails on any drift, and the fix is to read the model delta and re-record deliberately, never to re-record for green.
